summary: Object property-key coercion uses ToPrimitive with string hint and can run arbitrary user code.

tests.name: object key custom string
tests.input: let k={toString(){return 'x'}}; let o={}; o[k]=1; console.log(o.x);

tests.name: symbol-producing key
tests.input: let s=Symbol(); let k={[Symbol.toPrimitive](){return s}}; let o={}; o[k]=1; console.log(o[s]);

references: ECMAScript Language Specification, Type Conversion abstract operations (living specification)
